visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor low-angle shot looking up. A blonde woman in a grey jacket and two men (one in a white hoodie, one in a red cardigan) stand in a circle with a white Samoyed dog. They look down at the camera and join hands in the center of the frame against a white ceiling and bright light. (2) Cut to an outdoor low-angle shot under a clear blue sky. The same group is seen from below, holding hands in a circle as small chunks of snow are tossed or fall around them, creating a dynamic visual flurry. (3) The man in the red cardigan, now wearing a grey puffer jacket, holds the camera in a selfie-style shot. He is laughing heartily with mountains and snow-covered trees in the background. The blonde woman is partially visible behind him. (4) Wide shot of the snowy landscape showing two people holding a large red banner with white text and a face printed on it. The setting is a vast snowfield under a bright sun. (5) Back to a close-up selfie of the lead man grinning widely. A friend in ski goggles and winter gear stands behind him, smiling. (6) Final group shot where the trio raises their arms and cheers toward the camera in a celebratory gesture amidst the snow.
